digest.component_or_area: verification pipeline / LLM structured output parsing
propositions: Tolerant Pydantic parsing can produce structurally divergent responses that normalize to semantically empty results, incorrectly treated as valid review outcomes

Empty verification outcomes (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty after reshape) must not produce valid pass or valid empty reviews; this is enforced at the decision layer via no-verification → indeterminate rule

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets: clean parses, recovered parses, semantically empty outcomes, and unrecoverable responses; verify_findings implements this at the kernel level but pipeline consumers do not yet wire it
Flexible parsing and bounded retry behavior must be preserved across providers and model versions while rejecting semantically empty results

Live verification pipelines (plan_review_decide and code_review_decide) currently run reshape_verifications inline without calling verify_findings, preventing outcome_counts telemetry from reaching live streams
